question: Which Indian Nationalist leader spearheaded the peasants' agitation known as the Bardoli Satyagraha?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Vallabhbhai Patel.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sardar Vallabh Bhia Patel** led the **Bardoli Satyagraha**. 
 
• After its success, he became one of the greatest leaders of the** Indian independence movement.**
 
• The Bardoli Satyagraha was **a peasants' movement against the British government's decision to raise land revenue**.
 
• It took place in Gujarat in **February 1928.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Rajni Patel (1915–1982) was an Indian politician and barrister.
 
• **Karsanbhai Patel** is an** Indian billionaire businessman**, industrialist and founder of the **Nirma group a company.****​ **
 
• **Govind Ballabh Pant** was an Indian freedom fighter and the **first chief minister of Uttar Pradesh.**
